crossRefs.note: He came to Nazareth, where he had been brought up. He entered, as was his custom, into the synagogue on the Sabbath…
The book of the prophet Isaiah was handed to him. He opened the book, and found the place where it was written,
Ehud came to him; and he was sitting by himself alone in the cool upper room. Ehud said, “I have a message from God to…
The king turned his face around, and blessed all the assembly of Israel; and all the assembly of Israel stood.

people.name: Ezra
people.line: Priest; scribe; led a group of exiles back to Jerusalem.

translations.web: Ezra opened the book in the sight of all the people (for he was above all the people), and when he opened it, all the people stood up.
translations.bsb: Ezra opened the book in full view of all the people, since he was standing above them all, and as he opened it, all the people stood up.
translations.kjv: And Ezra opened the book in the sight of all the people; (for he was above all the people;) and when he opened it, all the people stood up:
translations.asv: And Ezra opened the book in the sight of all the people; (for he was above all the people;) and when he opened it, all the people stood up:
